name: Moriya Miku
source:
[b]An Expressionless Robot-[i]Senpai[/i][/b]

Zodiac: Gemini

A [i]senpai[/i] at Acacia Academy, she shares a room with [url=/c133874]Yui[/url] and [url=/c133875]Akari[/url] in the dormitory. Because of her self-paced personality and lack of expressions, she is nicknamed "Robot." She excels in both academics and sports, especially in electronic warfare. Since she is not good at socializing, she gets confused when it is time to instruct her [i]kouhai[/i].

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://orthrossoft.jp/character/miku.html#miku]official website[/url]]
